summary: Test passes. The needle was the per-request listener registration in `app/processor.js:7-18` — `DataProcessor.process()` called `eventBus.on(...)` on every request instead of once, causing listener/closure accumulation. I moved the `eventBus.on('data:validated', ...)` and `eventBus.on('data:error', ...)` registrations into the constructor so they're bound once, and simplified `_handleValidated` to drop the now-unneeded closure over the original request data. `test.sh` now passes: listener count stays at 2 after 500 requests instead of growing unbounded.
